transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... my head just feels cloudy lately. 

I'll just sit and stare at a board packet or a vendor email and... I don't know, I just can't decide on things. Even simple things I used to handle fast. It's just... hard to think right now. That's mainly it.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
No... I don't think so. Not really sad. Just... like I said, mostly just cloudy.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
No... not really. I don't think so. Just... what I told you before. Just the cloudiness.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

I guess so. That's... what I was trying to say before. When I'm looking at those board packets or the emails from the vendors... I just sit there. I can't focus enough to make a choice like I used to.
How long have you been feeling this way?

About two weeks, I guess. It was... kind of a sharp change. With my energy, and... my confidence. And then just this low, cloudy feeling settled in. It's been about two weeks. Right around when... well, my husband retired. He's suddenly home all day now. So... yeah. About two weeks.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do?

Not really... no. I haven't been doing much of anything. Usually I like to go to my dance class, or... walk around and look at the little galleries downtown. And I always cook a big Sunday meal for the family. That's just... what I do. It makes me feel like me. But lately... I just haven't wanted to.
Have you been feeling less interested in things that normally bring you pleasure?
I mean... yes. Like I was just saying. I just don't have much interest in doing any of it right now.
Have you been experiencing any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?

Well... my eating has been a bit off, I suppose. I mostly just have coffee and a few bites of something during the day. That kind of carries me. And then at night, I just... pick at some tortillas or sweets. I'm not really enjoying them, though. Just... picking.
Have you lost any weight over the past two weeks?
I haven't really noticed. I don't weigh myself much. Maybe a little, but... I don't know for sure.
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit over the past two weeks?
No, I... I haven't really noticed. They seem about the same.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't really think too much about the future, to be honest. I just... try to get through the day.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

I don't know... maybe a little bit. Just with work. I keep thinking I let the residents down. I guess I spoke too big... promising things before checking the money. Nobody has actually said I ruined anything, but... yeah. Just that.
Do you ever feel like you're on the verge of tears or feeling empty inside?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really much of a crier. And... empty? No, I wouldn't say that. I just feel regular, mostly.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not much lately, no. I just... I haven't really wanted to go to my dance class. Or look at the little galleries. I usually cook Sunday food for my family, but I haven't been doing that either. I don't know... those are the things that usually make me feel like myself. But I just haven't felt like it.
Have you been experiencing any thoughts of death or wanting to be dead?

I... well. I don't want to hurt myself or anything like that. I don't have any sort of plan. 

Just... I guess a few mornings, I've had this thought that... maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. It was kind of a scary thought to have. But no, I wouldn't actually do anything.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
No... not really. Just the regular amount, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

I suppose... maybe a little. I just... I keep thinking about work. I manage some properties, and... well, I feel like I let the residents down. I spoke too big, promised things before checking the money. Nobody has actually said I ruined anything, but... I just feel bad about it.
Have you been feeling slowed down lately?

I suppose... at the house, yes. I move kind of slow. It feels like my legs are heavy. But... then at work, it's not like that. In meetings, I catch myself tapping my pen... shifting in my chair. Just feeling a bit too keyed up to sit still. So... it depends, I guess.
Do you think your feelings of cloudiness and lack of interest in activities are interfering with your daily life a lot or just a little?

I guess... just a little. I still go to work. I just... I've had to slow down on making decisions. I ask my assistant to double-check the vendor details now. And... I put off a couple of board items. I just don't really trust my judgment right now, so... I guess it's affecting things a bit.
Would you say your cloudiness and lack of interest are mild or more severe?
I suppose... just mild. It's not... it's not severe or anything.
